Name: Raja
Description: Raja, the fearless tiger, rules the jungle with his majestic stripes and a heart full of adventure!

Name: Kavi
Description: Kavi, the gentle giant, loves splashing in the water and has a memory sharper than a computer!

Name: Milo
Description: Milo, the sneaky leopard, moves like a shadow and climbs trees like a pro parkour athlete!

Name: Dear
Description: Dear, the elegant deer, dashes through the forest with grace, always staying one step ahead!

Name: Luna
Description: Luna, the cuddly bear, enjoys long naps, sweet honey, and the coziest winter hibernation!

Name: Simba
Description: Simba, the mighty lion, roars loud enough to shake the savanna and loves a good mane-day!

Name: Gigi
Description: Gigi, the long-necked beauty, can reach the tastiest leaves and always keeps an eye on things from above!

Name: Stripe
Description: Stripe, the stylish zebra, believes in standing out with his natural black-and-white fashion!

Name: Joey
Description: Joey, the bouncy kangaroo, hops all day and has pockets deeper than any hoodie!

Name: Poo
Description: Po, the bamboo-loving panda, enjoys rolling around, eating, and mastering the art of relaxation!

Name: Dash
Description: Dash, the speedster cheetah, can outrun a sports car—at least for a few seconds!

Name: Fang
Description: Fang, the howling wolf, leads the pack and sings to the moon like a rockstar!

Name: Rocky
Description: Rocky, the tough rhino, may look rough, but deep down, he’s a big softie!

Name: Hippo
Description: Hippo, the water-loving giant, spends more time in the pool than a pro swimmer!

Name: Snap
Description: Snap, the grinning crocodile, has the strongest bite in town—better watch out!

Name: Kong
Description: Kong, the mighty gorilla, is strong, wise, and always the boss of the jungle gym!

Name: Pingu
Description: Pingu, the dapper penguin, waddles in style and slides on ice like a pro skater!

Name: Speedy
Description: Speedy, the fast-footed ostrich, may not fly but can outrun almost anything on land!

Name: Shelly
Description: Shelly, the slow and steady tortoise, knows that winning isn’t about speed but persistence!

Name: Blue
Description: Blue, the fabulous peacock, spreads his feathers to impress—fashion is everything!

Name: Cuddles
Description: Cuddles, the sleepy koala, spends most of the day hugging trees and dreaming of eucalyptus!

Name: Shadow
Description: Shadow, the stealthy jaguar, moves like a ghost and loves nighttime adventures!

Name: Laughy
Description: Laughy, the giggling hyena, always has the best jokes and the loudest laugh in the savanna!

Name: Sky
Description: Sky, the soaring eagle, rules the skies and sees everything from miles away!

Name: Rosy
Description: Rosy, the graceful flamingo, balances on one leg and loves dancing in the sunset!
